scenarios.title: Access SauceLabs Login Page URL
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure unauthenticated visitors can access the official SauceLabs login page at the specified URL.
preconditions: Web browser is available and connected to the internet.
steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/.
scenarios.expected_result: The SauceLabs login page is loaded successfully, displaying the username input, password input, and signin button.

scenarios.title: User Login Validation
scenarios.business_objective: Authenticate a standard user into the SauceLabs portal using valid credentials.
preconditions: User is on the login page at https://www.saucedemo.com/.
steps: Enter the username in the username input field.
Enter the password in the password input field.
Click the signin button.
scenarios.expected_result: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected into the SauceLabs application.

scenarios.title: Login Form Missing Required Fields Validation
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure the login form validates required credentials prior to submission and displays inline error messages when mandatory inputs are omitted.
preconditions: The web browser is open and navigated to https://www.saucedemo.com/.
steps: Navigate to the login page URL https://www.saucedemo.com/.
Leave the username and password fields blank.
Click the signin button.
scenarios.expected_result: Form submission is prevented, and inline error messages appear next to the relevant required input fields.

scenarios.title: Inline Error Message Display Placement Validation
scenarios.business_objective: Verify that form validation error messages are displayed inline next to the corresponding input fields when login validation fails.
preconditions: The user is on the SauceLabs login page at https://www.saucedemo.com/.
steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/.
Leave one or both required input fields (username/password) blank.
Click the signin button to trigger validation.
Verify the position and formatting of the displayed error messages.
scenarios.expected_result: Validation error messages appear inline directly adjacent to the relevant invalid or missing field.

scenarios.title: Standard User Login and Confirmation Redirection
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure standard_user can successfully authenticate using the login form and is automatically redirected to the confirmation page.
preconditions: The login page at https://www.saucedemo.com/ is accessible.
The user possesses valid credentials for standard_user.
steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/.
Enter standard_user into the username field.
Enter the correct password into the password field.
Click the signin button.
scenarios.expected_result: The standard_user is successfully authenticated and the application redirects the user to /confirmation.

scenarios.title: View Inventory Page and Verify Product List
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure authenticated users can view the full product catalog and page elements.
preconditions: User is logged in with valid credentials.
steps: 1. Complete login process with valid credentials.
2. Navigate to the Inventory page.
3. Observe the product list, header elements, shopping cart icon, and sort dropdown.
scenarios.expected_result: The Inventory page loads successfully displaying six products, each showing an image, title, description, price, and 'Add to Cart' button.

traceability.section: SC-M02-002: Verify All Inventory Items are Displayed

scenarios.title: Add Single Item to Shopping Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to select an item from the inventory and add it to their cart.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Locate a product on the Inventory page.
2. Click the 'Add to Cart' button for the selected product.
scenarios.expected_result: The product's button text changes to 'Remove', and the shopping cart badge count increments by one.

traceability.section: SC-M02-003: Add Single Item to Cart

scenarios.title: Remove Item from Cart via Inventory Page
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to deselect an item directly from the Inventory page.
preconditions: User is authenticated and has at least one item added to the cart.
steps: 1. Locate an item previously added to the cart displaying a 'Remove' button.
2. Click the 'Remove' button.
scenarios.expected_result: The item is removed from the cart, the button reverts to 'Add to Cart', and the shopping cart badge count decreases by one.

scenarios.title: Add Multiple Products to Shopping Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to select multiple distinct items and see accurate cart count updates.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click 'Add to Cart' on the first product.
2. Click 'Add to Cart' on a second distinct product.
3. Click 'Add to Cart' on a third distinct product.
scenarios.expected_result: All selected products show 'Remove' buttons and the cart badge accurately reflects the total unique count of selected items (3).

scenarios.title: Sort Products Alphabetically from A to Z
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to organize the product list alphabetically by name.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the product sort dropdown menu.
2. Select 'Name (A to Z)' option.
scenarios.expected_result: Products immediately rearrange in alphabetical order by name from A to Z.

scenarios.title: Sort Products Alphabetically from Z to A
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to organize the product list in reverse alphabetical order.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the product sort dropdown menu.
2. Select 'Name (Z to A)' option.
scenarios.expected_result: Products immediately rearrange in reverse alphabetical order by name from Z to A.

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Price Ascending (Low to High)
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to organize products starting from the lowest price.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the product sort dropdown menu.
2. Select 'Price (low to high)' option.
scenarios.expected_result: Products sort by ascending price, displaying the lowest priced item first.

traceability.section: SC-M02-008: Sort Products by Price (Low to High)

scenarios.title: Sort Products by Price Descending (High to Low)
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to organize products starting from the highest price.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the product sort dropdown menu.
2. Select 'Price (high to low)' option.
scenarios.expected_result: Products sort by descending price, displaying the highest priced item first.

traceability.section: SC-M02-009: Sort Products by Price (High to Low)

scenarios.title: Navigate to Product Details Page
scenarios.business_objective: Enable users to view detailed information for a specific product.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click on a product title or product image in the inventory list.
scenarios.expected_result: The user is navigated to the corresponding Product Details page.

scenarios.title: Open Shopping Cart Page from Inventory
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to view items currently in their cart.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page with items in cart.
steps: 1. Click the shopping cart icon in the top header.
scenarios.expected_result: The Shopping Cart page opens with previously added products retained.

scenarios.title: Open Sidebar Navigation Menu
scenarios.business_objective: Provide access to application navigation options via sidebar menu.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the hamburger menu icon at the top left of the page.
scenarios.expected_result: The sidebar menu opens, rendering navigation options accessible.

scenarios.title: User Logout via Sidebar Menu
scenarios.business_objective: Allow users to terminate their active session securely.
preconditions: User is authenticated and on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Click the menu icon to open the sidebar menu.
2. Click the 'Logout' menu option.
scenarios.expected_result: The user session is terminated and the user is redirected to the Login page.

scenarios.title: Verify Cart Badge Persistence Across UI Interactions
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure active cart items and badge counts are preserved during sorting or menu toggling.
preconditions: User is authenticated and has items added to the cart.
steps: 1. Add one or more products to the cart on the Inventory page.
2. Change product sorting order using the sort dropdown.
3. Open and close the hamburger sidebar menu.
scenarios.expected_result: The shopping cart badge retains its accurate count and added items remain selected without being cleared or modified.

scenarios.title: Refresh Inventory Page and Preserve Session State
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure page refreshes do not lose active session data or cart selections.
preconditions: User is authenticated and has added products to the cart on the Inventory page.
steps: 1. Refresh the web browser on the Inventory page.
scenarios.expected_result: The Inventory page reloads successfully, maintaining session state and preserving active cart selections and badge count.

scenarios.title: Enforce Non-Duplicate Product Selection in Shopping Cart
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure that users cannot add duplicate instances of the same product to the shopping cart, enforcing unique product selection and state management.
preconditions: User is authenticated and currently viewing the Inventory page.
steps: Click 'Add to Cart' for a selected product in the inventory list.
Observe the product action button and the shopping cart badge count.
Verify that the button state transitions to 'Remove' and no additional 'Add to Cart' action is available for that product.
scenarios.expected_result: The product button changes to 'Remove', preventing duplicate additions of the same product, and the cart badge count reflects exactly 1 unique product.

scenarios.title: Restrict Access to Inventory Page for Unauthenticated Users
scenarios.business_objective: Ensure system security by preventing unauthenticated access to the product inventory page.
preconditions: The browser session is unauthenticated and lacks a valid session state.
steps: Attempt to navigate directly to the Inventory page URL.
scenarios.expected_result: Access is denied and the user is redirected to the Login page in accordance with authentication security rules.
